subject: English
passage: US paper currency didn't always include the familiar set of denominations (1, 5, 10, 20, 50, and 100 dollar bills). Paper bills only ______ a few small denominations until larger denominations were added in the 1860s.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation:
Choice B is the best answer because it most logically completes the text's discussion of US paper currency. As used in this context, 'featured' means had as a characteristic or part. The text indicates that although US paper currency now includes a familiar set of denominations, this wasn't the case until the 1860s, when larger denominations were added. Before then, the text suggests, paper bills had fewer denominations (as indicated by the word 'only' in the second sentence). This context supports the idea that before the 1860s, paper bills featured only a few small denominations.

Why D is incorrect:

Choice D is incorrect because 'disregarded' means ignored or treated something as unworthy of notice, neither of which would make sense in context. The text doesn't discuss how people react to paper bills; rather, it addresses the idea that US paper currency has contained its familiar set of denominations only since larger ones were added in the 1860s. Moreover, the blank portion of the text describes 'paper bills,' which are lifeless objects and therefore unable to ignore or treat something in a particular manner.
